brief.text: Create a kinetic museum sculpture with bronze and teal curved fins, a deliberate flowing silhouette, a dark stone base and coordinated wave animation.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained sculpture with curved fins and coordinated pivot animation.

revisions.title: Mounting and silhouette revision
revisions.description: Added mounting plates and a framed plaque, then reshaped the height progression into a clearer wave.

revisions.title: Previous gallery revision
revisions.description: Curled the fin tips, moved upper clamps to follow the curved fins, and added plaque fasteners.

revisions.title: Flush faces fixed
revisions.description: Maintainer revision by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12): 1 part edit that separates faces lying on one plane, which flickered in any renderer. Materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged.
